_about: The pixel-art look of every floor (systems/floorArt.js draws it, no Phaser). pixel = screen pixels per art pixel. Each floor uses one of `variants` random layouts per tile colour (dungeons.json tileColors; tintShare = how much that colour tints the stones). Wall: stone bricks (brickH, brick widths), PILLARS (x centres in art pixels, width, capital/base), moss and vines from the top. Floor: old flagstones (row heights, stone widths) with dark dirt in the gaps, cracks, DIRT patches (count, radius), GRASS tufts (mostly near dirt and the walls), moss specks and pebbles, a shadow under the wall and darker side edges.

door._about: The door in the back wall (entities/Door.js): a stone arch (blocks, a lighter keystone), a dark wooden door of planks with two iron bands and rivets and a ring handle. Open = a black doorway.
